structure.unit: Virginia Revised Uniform Limited Partnership Act

text.section: The term "transacting business" as used in this section shall have no effect on personal jurisdiction under § 8.01-328.1.

The list of activities in subsection A of this section is not exhaustive. This section does not apply in determining the contracts or activities which may subject a foreign limited partnership to service of process or taxation in this Commonwealth or to regulation under any other law of this Commonwealth.
